About this Event

🎃 BOLLYWEEN 2026 IS BACK AND IT’S GIVING TRADITION 🎃

Philadelphia’s literal craziest Halloween tradition just dropped and it’s a total vibe. We are taking over Dolphin Tavern for Bollyween Night—the ultimate crossover event where spooky season meets high-key South Asian energy. We are talking upscale aesthetics, premium production, and an elite crowd. Whether you're here for the music, the looks, or the VIP treatment, this party is a mandatory attendance situation.

🎧 THE LINEUP IS STACKED
We have DJ Sarthak (Philly’s #1 Bollywood club DJ) and DJ Rayzonik headlining the night to absolutely carry the soundscape. Expect non-stop hits and pure ear candy:
Bollywood & Tollywood bangers that hit differentPunjabi anthems & Bhangra remixes to get everyone movingDesi Tech & Bolly EDM tracks that are absolute weaponsAfro House, club classics, and tech-house mashups that are straight fire✨ THE INSANE VIBE CHECK
Massive Costume Contest: Show up and show out because the "Best Dressed" are walking away with actual surprises.Upscale Energy: Elite lighting, sound, and a camera-ready atmosphere for your socials.Hastle-free Parking: No gatekeeping here—hassle-free parking is completely free on-site.🎭 THE DRESS CODE: AMERICAN OR DESI LOOKS
Go full main character energy! We need maximum effort on your American or Desi Halloween costumes. Whether you are pulling up in full cinematic filmy drip, a stunning Desi fit, or a classic spooky look—just don’t miss.

🎟️ TICKETS & VIP TABLE RESERVATIONS
Girls Who Get It: The first 50 ladies enter FREE (do not sleep on this).Don't wait until Halloween week and get FOMO. Grab your tickets, spam the group chat, and let's make it a night to remember!
